description: Twelve simulated months built from simulation_pool.csv. The pool is read in its original order (so the natural drift of the BAF data between real months 4-7 is kept); each month keeps rows with the drift probabilities below until it has its planned number of applications ('rows'). The downturn brings more applications (16,000 -> 20,000 per month).

months.story: Economic downturn starts: more applicants with low income who recently moved (+12 % applications)
Downturn gets stronger (+19 % applications) and the share of fraud rises
New credit bureau: credit_risk_score is now reported on a new scale (old value + 600)
Fraudsters start to copy the signals of normal applicants
Half of the fraud cases are camouflaged
New mobile form: no session length and an unknown device type for 30 % of applications
